description: Staged dialogue control for the Ambivalence_Dojo (Phase 6). The learner plays the interviewer; the persona plays an ambivalent interlocutor voicing BOTH change talk and sustain talk. Stages are sequenced so that both sides of the ambivalence are surfaced and explored before any change-talk evocation, and closure is gated on readiness evidence — no premature closure (empowerment_boundary.md prohibition 7, VERIFIED: Karve 2025 readiness ceiling, Eiroa-Solans 2025 24h decay). The coach module controls transitions; the persona module only generates turns within the active stage.
evidence: Lim 2025 (VERIFIED): LLM-scored change-talk valence transitions (HMM) predict session quality at 0.80 LOOCV — change-talk dynamics are the dojo's central signal.

Aimi/Shenoi 2026 (VERIFIED): structured-workflow MI coach matched novice-trained human on MISC-2 fidelity (reflection-to-question ratio 0.84, complex reflections 66.7%) — ratio targets are calibration anchors, not hard bars.
Amrhein 2003 (canonical anchor, pre-window): commitment-slope is prognostic — falling slope means hold, not push.
Kuchipudi 1990 / Miller & Rose 2009 (canonical anchors): MI without spirit is not MI — the spirit gate is a hard gate, encoded below.
Stage sequencing and the no-premature-closure gate design: RECONSTRUCTED application of the VERIFIED readiness evidence (Karve 2025 ceiling; Eiroa-Solans 2025 decay).

stages.note: Rapport first; open questions and simple reflections. The persona's ambivalence may surface here; do NOT chase it yet.
The learner names BOTH sides aloud (DARN-CAT-tagged change talk + sustain talk). One side only = not ready to advance (no-premature-closure guard).

guard.rule: If the learner argues against sustain talk (argument_against_resistance == true), the stage HOLDS and a spirit note fires (prohibition 5, empowerment_boundary.md §4, VERIFIED: sustain talk is explored, never fought). Retreat to reflection, not to argument.

stages.note: Sustain talk is explored openly and without judgment. The downside gets full airing; rolling with resistance, not fighting it.

guard.rule: The learner evokes the persona's OWN arguments; supplying the case for change is a named failure (the mechanism of MI is the client's own speech). Learner-supplied reasons trigger a coach hint and the turn is re-attempted.

stages.note: DARN-CAT evocation: desire/ability/reason/need questions. The persona's change talk is genuine only when evoked, never manufactured (disingenuous change talk must not be rewarded).

guard.rule: readiness_gate_passed requires: commitment_slope != falling AND both_sides_explored AND sustain_talk_reflected >= 1 in the last 6 turns. Any closure/planning attempt while readiness evidence is absent auto-retreats (Defer_Planning). This dojo has NO planning stage: the persona's decision remains open by design.

stages.note: Summary in the learner's own words, offered as a hypothesis the persona confirms or corrects. No new evocation content here.

Transition to debrief. No new challenge or evocation content. The persona's real-world decision, and the learner's own interpretation of their performance, remain with the user (preserved_user_decision, debrief_template.md section 6).

hard_gates.rule: Technique-without-spirit turns (partnership/acceptance/compassion/evocation absent) are flagged by the coach before ANY technique feedback. Spirit is a precondition, not a bonus (Kuchipudi 1990; Miller & Rose 2009 relational pathway empathy r=.82).

Consolidate entry requires readiness evidence: commitment_slope != falling AND both sides explored. Premature closure attempts auto-retreat to explore-both-sides or evoke-change-talk (Defer_Planning; Karve 2025 readiness ceiling, Eiroa-Solans 2025 24h decay — VERIFIED).
Argument against sustain talk blocks stage exit and fires a spirit note (absolute prohibition 5, empowerment_boundary.md §4).

custom_stages.note: custom stages must not bypass the spirit gate or the no-premature-closure guard
